entities.summary: Marsela Mari "Sela" Dela Cruz Guia is a Filipino actress, host and singer who is under ABS-CBN's Star Magic. She is a former member of the all-girl Filipino idol group MNL48. After leaving the group, she signed an exclusive contract with Star Magic in their historic "Black Pen Day" on June 19, 2021. Sela has since then continued with her solo singing and acting career. Starting May 2022, Guia became a regular host on PIE Channel's segment PIEsilog and was later on moved to PIEnalo: Pinoy Games.
